She was the first child of a couple who had denied consanguinity.

Even though consanguineous marriage was denied by the parents of P2, consanguinity could not be excluded based on the identification of a novel nonsense mutation in the homozygous state in the patient and the heterozygous state in both parents.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Nonsense, p.(Gln88Ter) (batch HGVS). The authors describe loss of the VWFA and cysteine-rich domains.

quotes.quote: One nonsense mutation, c.262C>T (p.Gln88Ter) in exon 4, which was identified in P2, leads to a premature stop at codon 88 which normally encodes for glutamine and results in loss of both active VWFA and cysteine rich domains of β2 integrin protein.

concerns: Parents denied consanguinity, yet the patient is homozygous; the authors say consanguinity could not be excluded.
Umbilical cord separation at 20 days is recorded as not delayed (Table 2 'No').
No CD18 flow cytometry was done, so the LAD-I diagnosis rests on clinical features and sequencing.
The authors' own consanguinity comment is quoted here for the panel: see in_trans.
notes_for_panel: Single Thai case report (P2, girl). Homozygous nonsense variant, both parents heterozygous. No CD18 study, no functional study.
